Subject: Handoff — Cedarbrook implementation kickoff (SOW signed)

Monica / Dev — quick handoff. Cedarbrook signed the SOW this morning (DocuSign link below) and want to start tenant activation the week of Apr 16. High-level asks from the pre-sale call:

- Dedicated workspace per environment (prod / staging)
- Seed one admin API key for automation + one human admin invite
- Role matrix with 3 roles: Org Admin, Billing Admin, Developer
- SSO planned via Okta (they'll share metadata)

Emily and Sanjay are on the thread for technical questions. Please propose a bare-minimum activation plan (who does what, dates, and anything we need from Cedarbrook) so we can lock the kickoff.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/CB-SOW-48291
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/CB-2028-042

Thanks — Grace

Thanks Grace — passing to the implementation team. Drafting a minimal activation plan below (we'll refine on the kickoff):

1) Pre-kickoff (by Apr 14) — Cedarbrook provides: Okta metadata, list of initial admin users, desired project names, environment naming convention.
2) Day 0 (Apr 16) — Redwood will: create org + prod/stage projects, seed one API admin key for automation, invite 1 human Org Admin, upload role matrix.
3) Day 1–3 — Dev will validate token-based CI jobs, configure basic routes, and confirm KV cache/policy defaults.
4) Week 1 — Turn on usage reporting for cost visibility; schedule 30m follow-up.

Ask for Cedarbrook: full name + email for the first Org Admin, and whether they want the seeded key in Vault or provided as a one-time export. We prefer storing the seed in their KMS when available; otherwise we'll provide a time-limited key.

I'll own activation coordination. Dev — can you prepare a role matrix and the seeding steps (I/O: attachments) and confirm whether we need a support escalation contact?

—Monica

Thanks — quick answers from our side:

- Org Admin: Emily Park (emily.park@cedarbrookhealth.com) — she'll be the human admin and initial point of contact.
- We want the seeded admin key exported as a one-time secret (no KMS integration for now).
- Okta metadata: attaching SAML metadata URL in a follow-up to IT (they'll send it by Apr 11).
- Preferred kickoff: Apr 16 at 10:00 AM PT.

One question: are the seeded keys scoped by project, or do seeded admin keys have org-wide privileges? We need to record the attack surface for internal compliance.

Emily

Emily / team — short answers and attached artifacts. Attachments: cedarbrook_initial_role_matrix.csv, api-key-seed-instructions.md

- Seeded admin key: by default our seeded admin key is org-scoped and can manage workspace-level resources. For least-privilege we can instead seed one Org Admin key (org-wide) and separate Project API keys for specific integration work. Recommend: 1 org-scoped admin key (time-limited, one-time export) + 2 project-scoped keys for staging & prod automation.
- If you want keys rotated into your Vault/KMS later we support that — guide in api-key-seed-instructions.md.
- Role matrix: CSV contains the three roles (Org Admin, Billing Admin, Developer) and recommended RBAC bindings. Please review the matrix and confirm any deviations before Apr 14.

Implementation checklist (short):
- Apr 11: Cedarbrook sends Okta metadata & confirm admin accounts.
- Apr 14: Redwood prepares org + projects and seeds keys (one-time export link).
- Apr 16 (10:00am PT): Kickoff call (10–30m) to validate invites and token usage.

If you want, we can create the one-time export link and send it to a Cedarbrook-specific secure email (it@cedarbrookhealth.com).

—Dev

Kickoff is confirmed for Apr 16 10:00 AM PT. I'll join with Sanjay and the IT lead. Looking forward to the brief walkthrough.
